name: Xendit

webhook.algorithm: NO HMAC AND NO SIGNATURE. Xendit sends a STATIC shared secret in the x-callback-token header, identical on every event, per account. There is no timestamp, no per-payload digest, and therefore no replay protection whatsoever. VERIFIED from docs.xendit.co/docs/handling-webhooks and integration-security. Generator MUST NOT emit HMAC code here. Correct handling: constant-time compare of the token, HTTPS-only, mandatory idempotency/dedup on payment_id + capture_id (Xendit's own documented advice), and IP allowlisting where offered. Flag the token as a bearer credential that leaks like a password.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: HTTP Basic where the SECRET KEY is the username and the password is EMPTY (the trailing colon before base64 is required — a classic integration bug). VERIFIED prefixes: xnd_development_ (test secret), xnd_production_ (live secret), xnd_publ

fees.notes: Published per-method, not per-card-percentage. VERIFIED examples: ID QRIS 0.70% incl. VAT + IDR 4,000 processing; ID Virtual Account IDR 9,000 + IDR 4,000 processing; PH GCash 3.00% + PHP 11.00; PH QRPH 1.50% (min PHP 15) + PHP 11.00. Indonesian PPN/VAT 11% applies on top of fees. Card rates vary by market — UNKNOWN, do not guess.

notes: One integration covers both of Southeast Asia's two biggest non-card markets (Indonesia and the Philippines) plus VN/TH/MY. Nothing shipped touches SEA at all. It is also the cluster's clearest security anti-pattern and must be flagged, not silently generated.
SDKs: node: xendit-node; python: xendit-python; php: xendit/xendit-php. Official and actively maintained.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps PayMongo in PH and Midtrans/DOKU in ID. If PagoKit ships only one SEA provider, this is the one — but it costs the generator a correct non-HMAC webhook path.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
